title: Isomorphisms and slow entropy of deterministic $[T,T^{-1}]$ systems
summary: We study skew product measure-preserving systems driven by an irrational rotation and the step function with values $1$ and $-1$ on each half of the circle. These systems can be seen as a deterministic version of Kalikow's $[T,T^{-1}]$ system, and are particular instances of Rokhlin cocycle extensions. Under the assumption of ergodicity, we show that these systems obey an interesting rigidity property for isomorphisms.
